name: Modeling the Water–Energy–Food Nexus in a Brazilian Periurban Watershed: An Agent-Based Simulation Under Climate Change Scenarios
description: Agent-based model (NetLogo) simulating Water-Energy-Food nexus dynamics in the Alto Tietê basin (UGRHI 6, São Paulo, Brazil) across a historical baseline and two IPCC AR6 climate scenarios (SSP2-4.5, SSP5-8.5) under fragmented vs. integrated water governance. Integrates open data from ANA, ANEEL, MapBiomas (Collection 10.1), and IPCC AR6.
